Test Case 4: Backend Activity Logs

Input:
  - Command: kubectl logs <backend-pod> --tail=50
  - Namespace: metabob
  - Pod selector: app=metabob-rpc-api
  - Log filter: grep 'POST.*activities'

Expected Output:
  - Log count: >0 (at least one POST request to /activities endpoints)
  - Sample log format: "POST /v2/activities/recommend"
  - Indicates backend is processing activity requests

Validation:
  - Fetch last 50 log lines from backend pod
  - Count lines matching 'POST.*activities' pattern
  - Verify count > 0
  - PASS if logs found (backend active), informational if not found

Note:
  This test is informational - it verifies backend is actively processing
  requests but doesn't fail validation if logs are absent (may just need
  more usage to generate logs).
